title: Protocol-Dependent Performance in Rotating Machinery Fault Diagnosis: Evidence from Sealed Compound Generalization
description: Reproducibility package for the Sealed Compound Generalization Protocol (SCGP), including manuscript-specific code, derived feature caches, split manifests, unit-level predictions, result files, and audit records. Raw third-party datasets are not redistributed.
